intro.title: What's really going on with screens at home?
intro.subtitle: A 3-minute reflection on the screen pattern showing up in your family.
intro.disclaimer: This takes about 3 minutes. It's a reflection of what you're observing around your child's relationship with technology and your family dynamic. It is not a diagnosis or medical advice.

emailGate.title: We think we see the pattern.
emailGate.body: Enter your name and email to unlock your family's full result and what may help.

result.secondaryPrefix: There may also be a thread of
result.missedQuestion: If none quite fit or we got something wrong, tell us what we missed about what's actually happening at home.

severityCopy.light: This reads like normal, manageable screen tension. A simple family media plan or a light reset is likely all you need right now.
severityCopy.moderate: There's one clear pattern here with a real cost. A practical plan now can keep it from hardening into something harder to undo.
severityCopy.high_support_need: This has grown into a real family pattern across several areas — repeated conflict, parent strain, or impact on sleep, school, mood, or trust. A parent consult or therapist-informed plan is genuinely worth it.
severityCopy.safety_urgent: Some of what you shared points to a safety, secrecy, or money-risk concern. This is the kind of pattern that deserves support sooner rather than later.

cta.title: You don't have to carry this alone.
cta.body: This is usually the kind of pattern that needs more than another screen-time rule. Blue Light CARES helps your child build other ways to regulate and reconnect, and helps you stop turning every limit into a fight.
cta.reassure: Support isn't a punishment for screen use. It's help for the routine, conflict, withdrawal, or safety pattern underneath it.
cta.lowReadyBody: When you're ready, Blue Light is here. You can save your result and come back anytime.
cta.safetyTitle: This needs more than a quiz.
cta.safetyBody: Some of what you shared points to a possible safety concern. Please reach out to a professional now. In the US you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) anytime, or call 911 in an emergency. Blue Light can also help you find the right support.
